goal: Fail fast on malformed transactions and blocks during deserialization
Prevent peers from causing excessive memory and CPU consumption before validation rejects them
agreement: No substantive feedback either way yet
Suggested scoping budget lifetime explicitly to wrappers rather than stream state (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it protects nodes against worst-case memory and CPU exhaustion from peers
Prevents deserializing blocks with up to 400,000 empty transactions or 16M weight before rejection
